description: Send a chat request to an open model running on Idemcore (OpenAI-compatible API). Returns the answer plus a signed receipt that proves which model, inputs and settings produced it, and checks the receipt signature locally.

messages.description: Full chat history in OpenAI format.

model.description: Model id; defaults to IDEMCORE_MODEL or the server default.

privacy.description: hash_only (default on the API) keeps only salted hashes.

seed.description: Sampling seed recorded in the receipt.

system.description: Optional system message, prepended when using `prompt`.

token_log.description: per_token keeps a per-token log so L2 can be checked later.

name: idemcore_chat
title: Chat with a signed receipt
